metadata.title: Update Types
metadata.description: A comprehensive reference of all OTA update types Capgo provides: apply timing, delay conditions, version blocking, and delivery methods.

blocks.text: Capgo supports several types of over-the-air (OTA) updates. This page lists and explains all of them so you can choose the right combination for your app.
